I'm excited to give this presentation on behalf of Nexflight
Labs. Ol enjoy attending this conference every year, and
this year, I get to lead a session! Today, Ill be sharing the
research on flying vehicles that Nexflight has done.
team ensures that the vehicles our company designs are
as light as possible. ® This is important because vehicles
that weigh less require less energy to operate. Over the
past decade, our company has developed four prototypes.
Of these, Nexfight is most proud of the model that can
accommodate six passengers.
Granted, 25 kilometers
isn't a long flight range, but it is a great start.
